name: Maya R. Chen
notes: Low-signal recent graduate; do not infer missing work history beyond visible entries.

sections.heading: OBJECTIVE
items: Recent computer science graduate seeking an entry-level software engineering role focused on internal tools, data workflows, and user-centered automation.

items.title: Course Planner Web App

items.title: Student Organization Check-In Tracker
